title: Program template day file
description: One day of a program template in the program template catalog, the only format the API imports. Catalog layout: $PROGRAM_TEMPLATE_CATALOG_DIRECTORY/<Name>/<any name>.json. Each folder is one template; its name must match ^[A-Za-z0-9 _-]{1,100}$ and becomes the template's name, so keep it neutral. Only the .json files directly in the folder are read; subfolders and other files are ignored. One file per date: the earliest date is day 1, a date without a file is an uncovered day, and a template spans at most 366 days. Write a folder atomically: fill <Name>.tmp, then rename it to <Name>; names containing a dot aren't catalog entries, so an incomplete folder is never listed or imported.

date.description: The day the workout is for, as YYYY-MM-DD; unique within the folder.

parts.description: The day's parts; the array order is the part order. At most arete.program.max-parts-per-day (20 by default).

examples: Back squat 5x5, Romanian deadlift 3x8, walking lunges 3x12.
